optimizedDescription.value: Global ChangeRepository port: bucketed versioned storage, serialized mutate, non-deciding hydration, indexed lists, confined artifact I/O.

optimizedContext.value:
# ChangeRepository Port

## Rules
- `ChangeRepository` `abstract class` extends `Repository`; inherited `workspace()`, `ownership()`, `isExternal()` default-only, unused. All application-facing ops abstract: `get`, `getDraft`, `getDiscarded`, `mutate`, `mutateDraft`, `list`, `listDrafts`, `listDiscarded`, `count`, `countDrafts`, `countDiscarded`, `reindex`, `reindexActive`, `reindexDrafts`, `reindexDiscarded`, `create`, `delete`, `artifact`, `saveArtifact`, `artifactExists`, `deltaExists`, `changePath`, `draftChangePath`, `scaffold`, `unscaffold`. Internal manifest-write helpers excluded.
- Storage global: active `changes/`, drafted `drafts/`, discarded `discarded/`.
- `get(name)` active-only → `Change|null`. Hydrates versioned manifest; missing serialized `state` → `missing` (legacy adaptation); `validatedHash` kept; MAY classify fresh physical file facts. MUST NOT persist validity, invalidate approvals, append events, move lifecycle, or rewrite manifest just to migrate. Snapshot only, not RMW primitive; atomic updates via `mutate`; operational validity via application reconciler.
- `getDraft` drafts-only → `DraftedChangeView|null` (per `core:drafted-change-view`); `getDiscarded` discarded-only → `DiscardedChangeView|null` via `toDiscardedChangeView` (`core:read-only-change-view`). Neither auto-invalidates nor persists.
- Load discriminates manifest version before version-specific validation; adapts v1 → v2 domain projection in memory; unsupported future version → typed manifest-version error.
- `mutate(name, fn)`: active-only; missing/draft-only → `ChangeNotFoundError`. Per-name exclusive lock; reload freshest `Change` without nested writes; `fn` gets `isDrafted === false`; persist on success; reload fresh file facts without applying/persisting validity decisions; unlock; return `{ result, change }` (post-save hydration; classification MAY differ from callback snapshot; not implied recovery). `fn` throw → no partial persist, lock released. Different names MAY run concurrently.
- Application reconciliation callback inside `mutate` alone owns validity decisions: evaluates fresh file facts, mutates review state, approval/verification projections, fingerprints, history/events, lifecycle return; v2 structured invalidation committed atomically. Later failed transition/archive MUST NOT undo committed recovery.
- `mutateDraft(name, fn)`: drafts-only; active-only/missing → `ChangeNotFoundError`; fresh `Change` with `isDrafted === true`; production callers only `RestoreChange`, `DiscardChange`, internals. Success persists manifest + any dir move, reloads via destination bucket non-writing hydration, returns `{ result, change }`; reload MUST NOT invalidate approvals or pick recovery. Failure → no partial persist, unlock.
- Repository exposes file reads for confirmed project-relative implementation paths; missing/unreadable/escaping paths reported explicitly, never silently excluded from fingerprint.
- `list` → `ListResult<ActiveChangeListEntry>`, `createdAt` asc; opt `includeDescription`. `listDrafts` → `DraftedChangeListEntry`, `draftedAt` desc; opts `includeDescription`, `includeReason`. `listDiscarded` → `DiscardedChangeListEntry`, `discardedAt` desc; opts `includeDescription`, `includeReason`, `includeSupersededBy`. Lightweight only (no aggregates/views/content/history/state maps). `include*` = projection only: field appears iff flag set and cached; index stores full payload; no extra `get`/manifest reads.
- `count`/`countDrafts`/`countDiscarded`: efficient, no aggregates, equal matching `meta.total`; Fs delegates to index helper `count()`.
- `reindex` (all), `reindexActive`, `reindexDrafts`, `reindexDiscarded`: force full rebuild of bucket under `{configPath}/tmp/fs-cache/`; callers never know JSONL layout.
- `create(change)`: only if absent in all buckets; atomic manifest (temp+rename) + dir; no artifact content; duplicate → `ChangeAlreadyExistsError` (or equivalent). `CreateChange` etc. MUST call `create`, never app-facing `save`.
- Existing-change manifest writes only inside `mutate`/`mutateDraft` (or locked repo internals). Internal helper not on port surface; never writes artifact content; drafted target outside `mutateDraft`/`mutate` window → `DraftedChangeReadOnlyError`.
- `delete` removes whole change dir.
- `artifact(change, filename)`: tracked artifact files only (else reject); returns `SpecArtifact|null`, `originalHash` = SHA-256 of disk bytes. `artifact`/`artifactExists`/related lookups confined to change dir; reject traversal, alternate encodings, untracked files. SHOULD debug-log resolution/rejections per global logging conventions.
- `saveArtifact(change, artifact, options?)` → `void`; requires active same-name `mutate`/`mutateDraft` window, else reject before any write; drafted outside window → `DraftedChangeReadOnlyError`. `originalHash` set and mismatched → `ArtifactConflictError`; `options.force` skips check. MUST NOT mutate in-memory `Change` (status, hashes, history, approvals, `setFileStatus`/`in-progress`).
- `artifactExists` presence only, no load. `deltaExists(change, specId, filename)` checks delta file under spec-ID subdir.
- `changePath(change)` absolute `changes/` path (active only), used for `TemplateVariables` `change.path`. `draftChangePath(view)` absolute `drafts/` path.
- `internalPaths()` → absolute owned paths or `undefined` if N/A (empty array = nothing to exclude). Fs: `changes/`, `drafts/`, `discarded/`.
- `scaffold(change, specExists)`: `scope: spec` → `specs/<ws>/<capPath>/` or `deltas/<ws>/<capPath>/` per async `specExists`; `scope: change` uses existing root. `unscaffold(change, specIds)` recursively removes both dirs per spec; idempotent.

## Constraints
- Global storage; workspace context unused.
- `get`, post-save reload, drafted/archived inspection never persist validity from hydration/legacy adaptation.
- List no default limit; omitted → full bucket, `meta.limit === meta.total`.
- New changes via `create`; existing only `mutate`/`mutateDraft`.
- `saveArtifact` writes bytes only; manifest validity belongs to application reconciliation.
- `ArtifactConflictError` sole artifact-byte concurrency error; `force` bypasses.
- `originalHash` = SHA-256 of disk bytes.
- Manifest writes atomic; `{ result, change }` post-save hydration is not automatic validity commit.
